title: Foundations: evidence, language models and work
outcome: Trace a small learned model and prepare a source-labelled investigation brief.

title: Conversations, tools and action boundaries
outcome: Build controlled interaction and distinguish a suggestion from an authorised operation.

title: Open models and inference
outcome: Run and inspect inference, compare hosting choices and design a contestable organisational record.

title: Evaluation and business value
outcome: Compare correctness, effort, waiting and service outcomes against explicit alternatives.

title: Organisational knowledge and retrieval
outcome: Build evidence retrieval with versions, access rules and routes for conflicting knowledge.

title: Data, categories and baselines
outcome: Prepare labels, compare simple baselines and inspect the work categories embedded in data.

title: Model adaptation and specialisation
outcome: Compare prompting, retrieval and adaptation using a reproducible independent example.

title: An AI service within an operating model
outcome: Connect technical contributions with roles, source ownership, review and recovery.

title: Agent loops and bounded autonomy
outcome: Construct a bounded tool loop with explicit evidence, budgets and stopping conditions.

title: Orchestration and accepted handoffs
outcome: Connect specialist contributions through inspectable results and acceptance conditions.

title: Teams and task dependencies
outcome: Compare decomposition choices against specialisation benefits and integration work.

title: Durable state and human review
outcome: Pause and resume work without reusing stale authority or repeating consequential actions.

title: Frameworks and interoperable contributions
outcome: Implement a common task in different frameworks while preserving meaning and uncertainty.

title: MCP and business capabilities
outcome: Expose a bounded service capability and distinguish discovery, identity, scope and authority.

title: From a business problem to a pilot
outcome: Develop requirements, a baseline, acceptance examples and an incremental build with coding agents.

title: Agent harnesses and operational evidence
outcome: Connect tools, instruction versions, evaluation, traces, latency and costs to service investigation.

title: Durable case handling at volume
outcome: Design queues, concurrency, review capacity, idempotency and recovery across people and services.

title: Enterprise context, security and controls
outcome: Connect owned definitions and policy sources with access boundaries, validation and failure handling.

title: Deployment and continuing service ownership
outcome: Move from a local service to optional cloud deployments, with change, support and retirement arrangements.

title: Governed improvement and integration capstone
outcome: Propose, review, evaluate and roll back service changes; defend a complete technical and organisational design.
